profile_text.body:
Raptor Technologies describes itself as a provider of integrated school safety software for K-12. According to its site, the platform lets schools screen visitors, track volunteers, report on drills, respond to emergencies, and reunite families, with the company framing these tools as a unified system that connects workflows, improves visibility, and makes reporting consistent. The site also describes campus intelligence tools that give schools real-time visibility into who is on campus and why, centralized data and processes intended to support early intervention and student wellbeing, training resources and compliance management, and Raptor Badge Alert, a wearable badge that lets staff activate alerts on what the company calls an end-to-end emergency management platform. The company says its solutions are built for schools, childcare programs, and youth centers, and it references a multi-day learning and collaboration event for the school safety community, as well as a conversation with Lauren Smith, Volunteer Mentor Program Coordinator at Champaign Community Unit School District, about managing volunteer access.

The company is tracked as a product in the education and research AI category, with a note that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified. Its listed use is visitor management and emergency tools for staff, as a staff tool rather than a student-facing one. AI features are not verified, privacy terms are not verified, and pricing is quote only with no published pricing. No lawsuits, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent facts are recorded.
